title: Django for Behavioural Science: tutorial and companion app
description:
A tutorial for behavioural scientists on hosting a jsPsych experiment on their own Django backend, and the companion application the tutorial builds. The researcher supplies a jsPsych timeline; the app serves it to participants, captures every trial, and exports the data.

Read it at andytwoods.github.io/django-for-behavioural-science. Companion to Woods (2026), Behavior Research Methods.

Dual licensed: the example code under MIT, the tutorial prose in docs/ under CC BY 4.0. Third-party images and the vendored jsPsych keep their own terms, listed in LICENSE-DOCS.
